about.title: About the Temporal Forces set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Temporal Forces is a Scarlet & Violet expansion released on 22 March 2024. It has 218 cards: 162 in the main set and 56 secret rares. For a master set there are also 140 reverse holos, and 52 special prints from other products and events.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 162 main set cards), the Complete set (all 218 cards), the Master set (358 cards, adding every reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (410 cards, adding the 52 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards)).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
